paite: Huan ama'n a-inkemmi kiang in ah, “Huai mite ip in apuak zoh zahzah buh in dimsak inla, adangka chiat uh a-ipgong bul chiat uah koih in.
heading: Nou Mang
english: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

paite: Ka nou, huai dangka nou, anaupangpenpa ipgong bul ah koih in, abuh man dangka toh," chi in thu apia hi. Huchi in ama'n Joseph thugen bang in ahihta hi.
english: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

paite: Khua avaktak in amau asabiltungte uh toh apaisakta hi.
english: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

paite: Khua a kipan apaikhiak ua gamla atun ma un, Joseph in a-inkemmi kiang ah, "Thou inla, huai mite va delh in. Na va phak chiang in akiang uah, 'Bangchidan a thil hoih, thil hoih lou a thuk na hi ua?
english: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?

paite: Huai ka pu uain dawnna leh a-aisanna mahmah hilou ahi maw? Hichibang na hih uh na gilou uhi,' chi in," achi hi.
english: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”

paite: Huan adelhphaktak in, huai thute akiang uah agen hi.
english: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Pu, bangchidan ahia hiai bang thute na gen? Na sikhate'n huchibang thil ka hihlouhdan ding uh.
english: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!

paite: Ngai in, ka ipgong bul ua dangka ka muhte uh leng Kanaan gam a kipan na kiang ah ka hon tawi ve ua oi. Bangchidan in na pu inn a dangka hiam dangka-eng hiam gu mawk ding ka hi ua?
english: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?

paite: Na sikhate lak ah kuapeuh na muhna penpen si hen, huan kou leng ka pu uh sikha in ka om mai ding uh," achi uhi.
english: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hi hen, na thu bang zel un hi hen. Himahleh kuapeuh ka hon muhna penpen ka sikha in om hen. Nou ahihleh dembei na hi ding uh," achi hi.
english: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”

paite: Huaitak in amau ip chiat uh kintak in lei ah angakhia ua, amau ip chiat ahong uhi.
english: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

paite: Ama'n a-upapen ah apan a, anaupangpen pha in azong a; huchi in Benjamin ip ah nou amuta hi.
english: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

paite: Huaitak in apuansilhte uh abotkek ua, amau sabiltung chiat aposak nawn ua, khua ah akik nawnta uhi.
english: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.

paite: Judah leh asanggamte'n Joseph inn ava pha ua; amah huai ah ana om lai hi. Huchi in amai ah abokkhup chiat uh.
english: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.

paite: Joseph in akiang uah, "Bang thil ahi mai a na hih uh? Kei bang mi in, aisan a hichibang thil mukhe thei ka hi, chih na thei kei ua hia?" achi hi.
english: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?”

paite: Judah in, "Ka toupa kiang ah bang ka genta ding ua? Bang ka hon hilhta ding ua? Bangchibang in ka kigenvengta ding ua? Pathian in na sikhate tatlekna amukheta. Ngai in, ka toupa sikhate ka hita mai uh. Kou leh akhut a nou amuhna pen uh leng," achi hi.
english: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? How will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”

paite: Ama'n, "Huchibang a ka hih louh ding dan. Akhut a nou amuhna pen kia ka sikha in a-om ding a, nou zaw lungmuangtak in na pa uh kiang ah paitouta un,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”

paite: Huaitak in, Judah in Joseph ava naih a, "Ka toupa aw, hehpihtak in, kei na sikha, ka toupa bil a na zak ding in thu kam khat hon gensak inla, na hehna na sikha tung ah kuangsak ke'n, nang lah Pharaoh bang hial na hita ngal a.
heading: Judah In Benjamin A Ding In Angetsak
english: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.

paite: Ka toupa'n, 'Pa hiam sanggam hiam na nei uhia?' chi in na sikhate na hon dong hi.
english: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’

paite: Ka toupa kiang ah, 'Pa putektak leh atek lam a neih naupang chik ka nei uh. Huai mipa upa asita a, anu neih lak ah amah kia a-om lai a, apa'n lah amah a-it mahmah hi,' ka chi uhi.
english: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

paite: Nang na sikhate kiang ah, 'Ka mit a amah ka muhtheihna ding in ka kiang ah hon pisuk un,' na chi hi.
english: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’

paite: Ka toupa kiang ah, 'Ka naupa un apa anuse thei kei ding; apa paisanleh apa asi mai ding,' ka chi uhi.
english: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’

paite: Nang na sikhate kiang ah, 'Na nautumpen uh na hon tonpih kei uleh, ka mel na mu nawn kei ding uh,' na chi hi.
english: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’

paite: "Huan hichi ahong hi a, na sikha ka pa uh kiang ka va tun un, ka toupa thute ka hilh uhi.
english: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

paite: Ka pa un, 'Kuan nawn unla, buh tawmchik bek ei a ding in va lei nawn un,' ahon chi hi.
english: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’

paite: Kou, 'Ka hohsuk thei nawn kei ding uh. Ka nautumpen uh ahong dingleh bel ka hohsuk ding ua, ka nautumpen un ahong pai keileh zaw huai mi mel mu thei lou ding ka hi uh,' ka chi uhi.
english: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’

paite: Na sikha ka pa un ka kiang uah, 'Ka zi in tapa nih ahon neihsak chih na thei uhi.
english: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.

paite: Akhat pen ka kiang a kipan apaikhia a, bohzan vek a om hi ngei ding ahi, ka chi hi. Huai nungsiah amah mu lou vengveng ka hi.
english: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.

paite: Huchi in hiai mi leng ka kiang a kipan na pikhiak ua, tuahsia va tuak taleh lungkhamtak a han a ka samkangpi toh hon tumsak ding na hi uh,' achi hi.
english: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’

paite: "Huchi in ka nau in kou hon zui lou in, na sikha ka pa uh kiang va tung leng, ka nau uh hinna toh ahinna akizop ziak in,
english: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;

paite: hichi ahong hi ding a, naupang in ahon zui kei, chih atheih chiang in asi mai ding. Huchi in na sikhate'n na sikha ka pa uh samkangpi toh lungkhamna a han a tumsak ding ka hi uh.
english: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.

paite: Na sikha in na kiang a ka hon pikik nawn keileh, amoh tangtawn in ka pa lak ah ka po ding, chi in ka pa kiang ah ka nau uh tungtang thu ah abultumpa in ka kibawlta hi.
english: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’

paite: Huchi in hehpih in na sikha ka nau uh sik in, ka toupa sikha in hon omsak zaw inla, ka nau asanggamte zuitousak in.
english: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.

paite: Ka naupa'n hon zui lou in bangchi in ka pa kiang ah ka paitou thei dia? Atung a siatna tung mu ding ka kei hiam," achi hi.
english: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”
